About the show

Theatre 118's irreverent take on panto returns: with an all-new script, absurd comedy, banging tunes and a twisted spin on a traditional fairytale!

Concessions at Theatre 118

Theatre 118 runs Pay What You Can on every show: the standard price is a suggestion, and nobody is turned away for paying less. There is a £1.50 booking fee per order.

No venue-wide concession scheme is published. Any reduction for this show will be on the booking page.

Open to everyone

Pay What You CanChoose your own price

Available on every show, whatever the standard price. Buyers choose what to pay, from the venue minimum up; there is no upper limit and no application to make.
